name: Fusion plasma microturbulence and energetic-particle benchmark
description: A suite of benchmark tests and standard problems for comparing fusion plasma simulation codes on microturbulence and energetic-particle dynamics.
general_score_metric: agreement with reference simulations / error norms on growth rates and transport fluxes
reputation: Well-regarded within the fusion-research community as a standard set of validation tests for microturbulence and energetic-particle simulation codes.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark requiring specialized simulation codes and HPC; results are sensitive to numerical details and input physics; not a large dataset in the ML sense; low risk of ML data contamination.
